blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.
blocks.zh: 确定一个人看谁对理解多党对话至关重要,然而,随着更多的人出现,仅仅看几何就变得模糊不清。 对话提供了几何学缺乏的提示,例如谁在说话和所说的话,但是没有央视数据集为许多多党派场景提供. 我们引入了SORBET,从1,578个有同步语音,文字记录的片段中取出3,340个样本的基准,以及出席的人物标签,覆盖的多党场景比现有的央视数据集还要多. 先前的凝视模型在努力使用这些以不同形式出现的提示时,必须和合适的人联系起来,并且可以与凝视几何相冲突. 我们提议Nunchi这个框架从文字记录和央视和扬声器模型的输出中构建出一个文本提示,将每个提示与候选人连接到共同的标签上,并让一个视觉语言模型(VLM)将央视几何与对话提示进行权衡,以识别受访者。 Nunchi的成绩比现有最强的方法高出4.8个百分点。 在SORBET上,对话提示有帮助,而额外视觉提示则无所助益,收益则贯穿三个VLM,并带有自动记录誊本,以及两个现有的数据集.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Whom each person looks at is central to understanding conversations among several people [ 19 , 29 ] .
Recognizing this social attention benefits applications such as education, healthcare, and human-robot interaction.
Existing gaze tasks address this question only indirectly.
Gaze following predicts where a person looks [ 33 ] , and social gaze predicts relations such as looking at humans (LAH) [ 15 ] .
We formulate attended person identification : given an observer and the other people in the scene as candidates , identify whom among the candidates the observer looks at, i.e . , the attended person .
We focus on multi-party conversations of three or more people [ 13 ] , where gaze alone is often ambiguous but the conversation offers cues.
blocks.zh:
每个人的视线对于理解几个人的对话[19,29]至关重要.
认识到这种社会关注有利于教育、保健和人与机器人的互动等应用。
现有的凝视任务只是间接地解决这一问题。
盖兹之后预测一个人的外观[33],而社会凝视则预测人(LAH)等关系[15].
我们制定有出席人员身份:给一名观察员和现场其他人作为候选人,确定观察员所看望的候选人中谁,即出席人员。
我们专注于三人或更多人的多党对话[13],

blocks.en:
Existing methods can identify the attended person in two ways.
Gaze following methods such as Gaze-LLE [ 35 ] predict the gaze target as a location on a heatmap [ 33 , 38 , 37 ] , from which the attended person can be selected by the heatmap mass or peak.
Social gaze methods such as MTGS [ 15 ] predict the LAH probability of each person.
Both rely on gaze geometry, which relates the gaze direction of the observer to the positions of the candidates.
They perform well when few people are present.
However, their accuracy decreases as more people appear in the scene, as shown in Tab. 1 .
On VAT [ 8 ] , for example, the accuracy of Gaze-LLE drops from 83.9% with two other people to 64.3% with five or more.
With more people, several of them often lie in a similar direction from the observer.
A small error in the estimated direction then changes the selected person. Fig. 1 shows such a case.
Gaze geometry alone is thus often ambiguous when many people are present.
blocks.zh:
现有方法可以有两种方式识别受助人.
Gaze-LLE[35]等方法的Gaze-LLE[35]预测视线目标为热映射上的位置[33,38,37],从中可以由热映射质量或峰值选择受助人.
MTGS[15]等社会凝视方法预测每个人的LAH概率.
两者都依靠凝视几何,这把观察员的凝视方向与候选人的立场联系起来。
很少人在场时表现良好。
然而,正如Tab所示,随着更多的人出现在现场,它们的准确性会下降. 1 (英语).
例如,在增值税[8]方面,Gaze-LLE的准确性从另外两人的83.9%下降到5人或5人以上的64.3%。
随着人数的增加,其中数人经常从观察者那里向类似方向躺着.
估计方向的小错误会改变选定的人。 图1显示了这样的情况。
因此,当许多人在场时,仅盖兹几何就往往模糊不清。

blocks.en:
Conversations provide cues that gaze geometry lacks [ 29 ] .
We consider two conversational cues [ 13 ] , the speaker cue for who is speaking and the transcript cue for what is said.
Listeners often look at the current speaker [ 19 ] .
A speaker may also name the observer, as in “Ross, come here,” which draws the attention of the observer to the speaker.
Prior gaze models have used the speaker [ 15 , 17 ] , but with limited success.
We attribute this to two factors, the lack of multi-party gaze datasets with conversational cues and the way the cues are used.
As shown in Tab. 2 , no existing gaze dataset combines video, synchronized speech, and transcripts with many multi-party samples.
blocks.zh:
对话提供了凝视几何缺失的提示 [29].
我们考虑两个谈话提示 [13], 发言者提示谁发言, 和记录提示 所说的话。
听者经常看当前的演讲者[19].
发言者也可像“Ross, come here”中那样给观察员点名,该词提请观察员注意。
先前的凝视模式使用了扬声器[15,17],但成功有限.
我们将此归咎于两个因素,即缺乏多党的视星等数据集与对话提示以及提示的使用方式.
如塔布所示. 2,没有现有的凝视数据集将视频,同步语音,以及记录誊本与许多多党样本相结合.

blocks.en:
We therefore build SORBET (SOcial gaze Recordings with Both spEech and Transcripts), a dataset of 3,340 samples of multi-party conversations from three TV series, each with synchronized speech, a transcript, and an attended person label.
Its keyframes come from 1,578 clips across 241 episodes, and each shows at least three people and the speaker, so the samples cover diverse multi-party scenes.
SORBET thus allows us to train models with conversational cues and to measure how much each cue helps.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们建立了SORBET(SORBET),它是一个由3,340个多党对话样本组成的数据集,来自3个电视连续剧,每集都有同步的演讲、记录稿和出席者标签。
它的关键框架来自241集的1,578个片段,每个片段至少显示三个人和扬声器,因此样本覆盖了各种各样的多党场景.
因此,SORBET使我们能够用对话提示来训练模型,并衡量每个提示有多大帮助。

blocks.en:
Even with such data, combining these cues with gaze raises three core challenges related to multimodal learning [ 22 ] .
First, the cues are heterogeneous [ 22 ] .
Gaze geometry is a heatmap over the image, the speaker cue is a score per person, and the transcript is a sequence of utterances.
Fusing them at the feature level brings little gain, as MTGS [ 15 ] reports for its speaking-status input.
Second, the cues are not automatically aligned with the people in the image.
A voice or a name helps only when it is linked to the right face.
Third, the cues can conflict.
Gaze geometry may favor one candidate while the speaker cue favors another, so the model must reason over both.
blocks.zh:
即使有了这些数据,将这些提示与目光结合起来,也提出了与多式联运学习有关的三个核心挑战。
首先,提示是不同的 [22].
Gaze几何是图像之上的热图,扬声器提示是每人得分,记录稿是语音的序列.
由于MTGS[15]报告其发言状态输入,在功能层面将其组合起来没有什么好处。
第二,提示并非自动与画面中的人对齐.
声音或名字只有在与右面相连接时才有帮助.
第三,提示可以冲突。
盖兹几何可能有利于一名候选人 而演讲者则有利于另一名候选人 因此模型必须同时解释

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose Nunchi 1 1 1 Nunchi is a Korean word for reading the room, where nun means eye. A person with nunchi knows who is paying attention to whom by watching where people look and listening to who is talking and what they say. Our model does the same. , a framework that addresses each challenge with a dedicated design.
For heterogeneity, Nunchi writes expert outputs as text in a shared language space.
VLMs estimate gaze direction less accurately than dedicated gaze models [ 41 , 40 ] , likely because they are trained for semantic understanding rather than precise spatial geometry.
We therefore use a frozen Gaze-LLE to estimate the gaze geometry, and call its output the gaze prior.
A frozen active speaker detector provides the speaker cue, and the transcript what is said.
For alignment, we draw each candidate’s face box with a label C k C_{k} on the image as a visual prompt [ 45 ] , and use the same labels in every cue.
For reasoning under conflict, a VLM reads the gaze prior and the conversational cues together and scores every candidate in a single forward pass.
Unlike fusion modules that mix features, this design lets the model compare gaze geometry and conversational cues explicitly for each sample.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议Nunchi 11 1 Nunchi是一个朝鲜语词,用于阅读房间,其中修女的意思是眼睛. 一个有尼古力的人知道谁在关注谁, 看着人们的视线, 我们的模型也是一样 一个专门设计来应对每个挑战的框架
对于异质性,Nunchi在共享语言空间中将专家产出写成文本.
VLMs估计视线方向比专用视线模型[41,40]更准确,可能是因为它们受过语义理解训练,而不是精确的空间几何.
因此我们用冰冻的Gaze-LLE来估计视线几何,并将其输出称为视线。
一个冷冻的主动扬声器探测器提供扬声器提示,以及上面所说的记录。
并使用相同的标签。
对于冲突下的推理,一个VLM读取了前视线和对话的提示,并在单个前传中给每个候选人打分.
与混合特征的聚变模块不同,这种设计允许模型对每个样本的显眼几何和对话提示进行对比.

blocks.en:
Nunchi reaches 86.7% on SORBET, 4.8 points above the strongest existing method.
With five or more candidates, it is 8.0 points above the best baseline.
Given the same speaker scores, Nunchi gains 1.9 points, whereas MTGS gains 0.8.
The conversational cues complement the gaze prior across three VLMs.
In contrast, additional visual cues, such as depth and mutual gaze, do not improve accuracy, whether given as text or drawn on the image.
These gains hold with automatic transcripts and on two existing datasets.
blocks.zh:
Nunchi在SORBET上达到86.7%,高于现有最强方法4.8分.
有5个或更多候选人,比最佳基线高出8.0分。
鉴于发言者的得分相同,Nunchi获得1.9分,而MTGS获得0.8分。
对话提示补充了前三个甚高频的视线。
相比之下,额外的视觉提示,如深度和相互视线,无论是作为文字给出的还是在图像上绘制的,都没有提高准确性.
这些收益带有自动记录和两个现有数据集。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. 1. We formulate attended person identification in multi-party conversations as a choice among the candidates, and show that gaze alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear, while conversational cues reduce this ambiguity. 2. We build SORBET, to our knowledge the first benchmark for identifying the attended person in multi-party conversations with synchronized speech and transcripts. It contains 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips across diverse scenes, and provides attended person labels, an evaluation protocol, and results of gaze following, social gaze, and VLM baselines. We will release the annotations. 3. We propose Nunchi, a framework that identifies the attended person by combining gaze with speech and transcripts. It writes the expert outputs as text, ties every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and scores the candidates with a single VLM.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下。 1. 在多党对话中,我们确定有出席人员的身份,作为候选人的选择,并表明,随着更多的人出现,单独视线变得模糊不清,而对话提示则减少这种模糊不清。 2. 我们建立了SORBET, 据我们所知,这是在多党对话中识别参与者的第一个基准,有同步的演讲和记录。 它包含来自不同场景的1,578个剪辑的3,340个样本,并提供了受关注的人的标签、评价协议以及随后的凝视结果、社会凝视和VLM基线。 我们将发布说明。 3. 我们建议Nunchi,通过将目光与讲话和录音笔录结合起来,确定受助者。 它将专家产出写成文字,将每个提示与候选人有共同的标签,并以一个VLM给候选人打分。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Gaze following predicts where a person looks in an image [ 33 , 7 ] , with extensions to video [ 8 ] .
Several methods incorporate depth or 3D cues [ 11 , 5 , 16 ] , or object-level information [ 39 , 25 ] to separate targets at different distances.
Sharingan [ 38 ] efficiently predicts multiple people’s targets at once with per-person gaze tokens.
Gaze-LLE [ 35 ] shows that a frozen general-purpose encoder with a lightweight decoder achieves state-of-the-art results; we adopt it as our gaze expert.
These methods output a location, and selecting the attended person from it becomes ambiguous when several people lie in a similar direction.
In contrast, Nunchi resolves such cases with conversational cues.
blocks.zh:
Gaze 之后预测一个人在图像中视线的位置[33,7],视频的扩展[8].
几种方法包含深度或3D提示[11,5,16],或对象级信息[39,25]在不同距离上将目标分开.
分享[38]高效预测多人目标,
Gaze-LLE [35] 显示一个带有轻量级解码器的冷冻通用编码器取得了最新的结果;我们把它作为我们的凝视专家.
这些方法输出出一个位置,当几个人处于类似方向时,从中选择受助人变得模糊不清.
相反,Nunchi用对话的提示来解决这类案件。

blocks.en:
Social gaze methods detect mutual gaze in videos [ 24 ] and images [ 9 ] , gaze communication [ 10 ] , and joint attention [ 26 ] .
Gupta et al . [ 14 ] and MTGS [ 15 ] jointly predict gaze targets and social gaze relations, including LAH.
MTGS processes multiple people over time, and its VSGaze dataset unifies several video datasets with social gaze labels.
Meeting studies estimate the visual focus of attention (VFOA) of each participant among a fixed set of targets from head pose [ 2 , 36 ] .
Ba and Odobez [ 3 ] add speaking status as context, and Otsuka et al . [ 29 ] use utterances to infer conversation structure.
These studies consider about four participants at fixed seats.
Attended person identification is a person-level form of VFOA, which we study from a single keyframe of TV conversations with three to more than six people in varying arrangements.
blocks.zh:
社会凝视方法在视频[24]和图像[9]中检测到相互凝视,凝视通信[10],以及共同关注[26].
Gupta等人[14]和MTGS[15]共同预测目视目标和社会目视关系,包括LAH.
MTGS随着时间的推移处理多人,其VSGaze数据集统一了数个带有社会凝视标签的视频数据集.
会议研究估计,在一组固定目标中,每个参加者的视觉关注焦点[2、36]。
Ba和Odobez [3] 加上发言状态作为上下文,Otsuka等人[29] 用言论推断对话结构。
这些研究在固定席位上考虑大约四名参加者。
出席者身份鉴定是VFOA的一种人级形式,我们从一个电视谈话的单一关键框架来研究,在不同的安排下与3至6人以上交谈.

blocks.en:
GazeFollow [ 33 ] provides gaze targets in images, and VAT [ 8 ] and ChildPlay [ 37 ] extend them to videos, including targets outside the frame and children.
UCO-LAEO and AVA-LAEO [ 24 ] label people looking at each other in TV shows and movies, and VGS [ 17 ] brings audio to gaze following in conversations.
As shown in Tab. 2 , none of them provides transcripts, and few of their test samples have three or more candidates.
Multi-party conversation datasets [ 43 , 48 ] provide speech, transcripts, and speaker labels but no gaze labels, which SORBET adds.
blocks.zh:
Gazeaflow [33] 在图像中提供目视目标, VAT [8] 和ChildPlay [37] 将其扩展至视频,包括镜头外的目标和儿童.
UCO-LAEO和AVA-LAEO[24]在电视节目和电影中标注人们互相看对方,VGS[17]在对话中带来音频来注视.
如塔布所示. 2,其中无一提供笔录,其测试样本中很少有三个或三个以上的考生.
多方对话数据集[43,48]提供语音,录音笔录,和扬声器标签,但没有央视标签,SORBET也添加了这些标签.

blocks.en:
MMGaze [ 17 ] introduces audio into gaze following in conversations, on videos with up to four people.
MTGS [ 15 ] accepts a speaking-status input and reports little LAH change from it.
Active speaker detection finds who is speaking from audio and face tracks [ 34 , 23 ] , but not whom the others look at, and we use it as a cue extractor.
Lee et al . [ 21 ] align utterances with the visual features of each player to identify whom a speaker addresses in social deduction games, and Ouyang et al . [ 30 ] align them inside the attention of a multimodal LLM, but neither considers gaze targets.
VL4Gaze [ 41 ] and Eyes on VLM [ 40 ] evaluate how well VLMs understand gaze, including gaze following and social gaze.
GazeLLM [ 47 ] reasons over structured scene representations to find gaze targets, and GTA [ 28 ] draws the predicted gaze as an arrow and asks a VLM to name the attended object.
These works use only the image and identify objects, while Lee and Deng [ 20 ] predict gaze directions in three-person conversations from transcripts without images.
To our knowledge, no prior gaze model combines transcripts with the image.
Nunchi gives a VLM the gaze prior and conversational cues as text and identifies the attended person.
blocks.zh:
MMGaze [17] 将音频引入视线,
MTGS [15] 接受一个发言状态输入,并报告LAH与它相比没有什么变化。
主动的扬声器检测发现谁在用音频和脸轨说话 [34, 23], 但不是其他人看的人, 我们用它作为提示提取器。
Lee et al. [21] 将言论与每个玩家的视觉特征一致,以识别一个演讲者在社会扣除游戏中向谁说话,Ouyang et al. [30] 将其与多式联运LLM的注意力一致,但既不考虑视线目标.
VL4Gaze [41] and Eyes on VLM [40] 评估VLM如何理解视线,包括跟踪视线和社会视线.
GazelLLM [47] 结构化场景表达方式上的理由来寻找凝视目标,GTA [28] 绘制预测的凝视作为箭头,并要求一个VLM来命名被显示的对象.
这些作品只使用图像和识别对象,而李和邓[20]则从没有图像的文字记录中预测三人对话中的视线方向.
据我们所知,没有前期的目视模型能将记录和图像结合起来。
Nunchi给一个VLM的前视线和对话提示作为文本,并识别参与者。

blocks.en: 3 The SORBET Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 SORBET 数据集

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Construction of SORBET. From two multi-party conversation datasets, we keep frames with at least three identified people and a visible speaker, and take the middle frame of each segment of such frames as a keyframe.
Each identified person serves in turn as the observer, and the annotator labels what the observer looks at.
SORBET keeps samples whose gaze target is a candidate.
blocks.zh:
图2:SORBET的建造。 从两个多党对话数据集中,我们保存着至少三个识别的人和一个可见的扬声器的帧,并将这些帧的每个段的中间帧作为键框.
每个被识别的人反过来担任观察员,而注释者则标注观察员所看到的.
SORBET 保存其目视目标为候选对象的样本.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 2 , no existing gaze dataset provides synchronized speech and transcripts for conversations among three or more people.
We therefore extend two existing multimodal multi-party conversation datasets [ 43 , 48 ] with manually labeled attended persons.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所示. 2,没有现有的凝视数据集为三个或更多人的对话提供同步的语音和文字记录.
因此,我们扩展了两个现有的多式联运多方对话数据集[43、48],人工标注了参与者的标签。

blocks.en:
Friends-MMC [ 43 ] covers 220 episodes from 10 seasons of the TV series Friends , with video clips, transcripts, face bounding boxes, character identities of faces, and speaker labels.
MIntRec2.0 [ 48 ] is a multimodal intent recognition dataset collected from Friends , The Big Bang Theory (BBT), and Superstore , with video clips, transcripts, and speaker labels but no face bounding boxes or character identities.
As its Friends subset overlaps with Friends-MMC, we use only BBT and Superstore .
Both datasets provide a video clip with synchronized speech for each utterance, together with its transcript and speaker label, so the speech is diarized at the utterance level.
We call people whose faces have a character identity identified people.
Friends-MMC provides these identities, and we assign them for MIntRec2.0 as described below.
blocks.zh:
Friends-MMC [43] 覆盖电视连续剧"Friends"10季的220集,有视频剪辑,笔录,面框,面部人物身份,以及扬声器标签.
MintRec2.0 [48] 是一个从Friends, The Big Bang Theory(BBT)和Superstore收集的多模式意图识别数据集,有视频剪辑,笔录,和扬声器标签,但没有面框或字符身份.
我们只使用BBT和Superstore。
这两套数据集都为每句话提供带同步语音的视频剪辑,同时提供其记录和扬声器标签,因此语音在语音级别上进行配音.
我们称其脸部有特征识别的人。
Friends-MMC提供这些身份,我们为MintRec2.0指定这些身份如下所述。

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 2 , we process both datasets in the same way.
MIntRec2.0 does not provide the episode of each clip, which we need to split the data at the episode level.
We therefore infer pseudo-episodes from its dialogue IDs, which group the utterances of one conversation, and from utterance timestamps, as detailed in the supplementary material.
PySceneDetect [ 6 ] detects shot boundaries in both datasets.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,我们以同样的方式处理两个数据集。
MintRec2.0没有提供每个片段的插曲,我们需要在片段级别上分拆数据.
因此,我们从其对话ID中推断出伪异体,对话ID将一次谈话的言论归为一类,并从补充材料中详述的言论时间戳推断出伪异体。
PyScene Detect [6] 探测到两个数据集的射击边界.

blocks.en:
We build face tracks within each shot and cluster them by face embeddings.
We assign a character name to each cluster from the speaker labels of clips that contain a single visible face.
The resulting identities agree with LR-ASD [ 23 ] , an independent active speaker detection model, on 93–94% of multi-face utterances whose speaker is among the identified people.
Faces in unnamed clusters are used neither as observers nor as candidates, and details are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们在每个镜头中搭建面孔 并用面孔嵌入它们
我们从包含单一可见面孔的片段的扬声器标签中为每组指定一个字符名称.
由此产生的身份与LR-ASD[23]一致,LR-ASD是一个独立的主动扬声器检测模型,在93%-94%的多面语中,扬声器是被识别的人之一。
无名集群中的面孔既不作为观察者,也不作为候选人使用,细节见补充材料.

blocks.en:
We keep frames in which (a) at least three identified people are visible, so that every observer has at least two candidates, and (b) the speaker of the clip is visible, so that the speaker cue is defined for every sample.
Consecutive kept frames within a shot form a segment, and we take the middle frame of each segment of at least 24 frames, about one second, as a keyframe.
One keyframe per segment avoids near-duplicate samples.
Each identified person in a keyframe serves in turn as the observer, and the other identified people are their candidates.
A sample is thus a (keyframe, observer) pair with K K candidates, and we obtain 7,323 samples from 2,410 keyframes for annotation.
blocks.zh:
我们保留了以下框架:(a) 至少有3名被识别的人可见,使每个观察员至少有两名候选人;(b) 片段的发言者可见,使每个样本的发言者提示得到定义。
连续将帧固定在一个镜头内形成一段,我们把至少24帧的每个段的中间帧,大约1秒,作为键框.
每段一个键框可以避免几乎重复的样本.
关键框架中的每个被确定的人反过来担任观察员,其他被确定的人是其候选人。
因此,一个样本是KK候选物(键框,观察者)的对子,我们从2,410个键框中获得了7,323个样本进行注释。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据注释

blocks.en:
Our Gradio-based interface [ 1 ] shows the keyframe with face boxes, the surrounding clip with audio, and the transcript of the utterance, but no model predictions such as gaze heatmaps or speaker scores.
Each sample is labeled as stable with one target, as shift when the gaze moves between two targets at the keyframe, or as unresolvable.
The target is a candidate, an object, something off-screen, or a person without a face box.
In the first pass, 45.8% of samples have a candidate as the final target, as detailed in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们基于Gradio的界面 [1] 显示带有面盒的键框,带音频的周围剪辑,以及语音的笔录,但是没有央视热图或扬声器分数等模型预测.
每个样本都标注为一个目标的稳定,如在键框上两个目标之间的视线移动时发生转移,或无法解决.
目标是一个候选者,一个物体,一个非屏幕的东西,或者一个没有脸盒的人.
在第一次通过时,45.8%的样本以候选人为最终目标,详见补充材料.

blocks.en:
We measure agreement with Cohen’s κ \kappa within the annotator and Fleiss’ κ \kappa across annotators, both of which correct for chance agreement and equal 1 for perfect agreement.
The annotator re-labels 100 samples per TV series without seeing the earlier labels, giving κ \kappa of 0.82, 0.93, and 0.87 for Friends , BBT, and Superstore .
The annotator and five others also label 100 common test samples.
Another annotator who chooses a candidate picks the annotator’s candidate in 93.6% of cases.
On the 57 samples where all six choose a candidate, Fleiss’ κ \kappa is 0.95.
Most disagreements concern whether the target is a candidate at all, as 77 of the 104 disagreeing labels mark an object, something off-screen, a gaze shift, or an unresolvable target. Section 5.4 also tests the cues on datasets labeled by others, and agreement over all label types is in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们衡量科恩在注释人和Fleiss在注释人之间所达成的一致,
注释员每部电视连续剧重新标注100个样本,没有看到之前的标签,给出的\kappa为0.82,0.93,朋友,BBT,和Superstore为0.87.
注释员和另外五个人还标注了100个常见的测试样本.
另一位选择候选人的书记员在93.6%的情况下选择了书记员候选人.
在57个样本中,
多数不同意见都涉及目标是否是候选目标,因为104个不同意的标签中有77个标有物体、非屏蔽物、视线转变或无法解决的目标。 第5.4节还测试他人标注的数据集上的提示,补充材料中载有对所有标签类型的协议。

blocks.en:
SORBET keeps only samples whose final target is a candidate.
Whether the observer looks at a person is the LAH task [ 15 ] , and we address the next question, whom among the candidates the observer looks at.
Rules for shift samples are in the supplementary material.
The resulting SORBET dataset contains 3,340 samples from 241 episodes.
As shown in Tab. 3 , we split it at the episode level into 1,839 training, 658 validation, and 843 test samples.
The attended person is the current speaker in 57.8% of samples, so the speaker alone does not determine the answer.
blocks.zh:
SORBET只保存其最终目标是候选人的样本.
观察者看一个人是否是LAH的任务[15],我们处理下一个问题,观察者看的是哪些候选人.
转移样品的规则载于补充材料。
由此产生的SORBET数据集包含来自241集的3,340个样本.
如塔布所示. 3,我们在剧集一级将其分为1,839个训练,658个鉴定,843个测试样本.
在57.8%的样本中,受助者是现任演讲者,因此单凭演讲者不能决定答案.

blocks.zh: 表3:SORBET拆分情况 分片在剧集层面是脱节的. K K是每个样本的候选人数量. Spk.是目标为当前扬声器的样本的百分比.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Overview of Nunchi. Cue extraction obtains gaze and speaker information with frozen experts, along with the transcript.
Prompt construction writes them as text, and every cue refers to each candidate by the label C k C_{k} drawn in the keyframe.
Candidate scoring reads the two images and the prompt with a single VLM and scores each candidate by the logit of its label.
In this example, the gaze prior and the speaker cue point to different candidates, and Nunchi selects the attended person C 2 C_{2} .
Colors mark the gaze prior, speaker, and transcript paths, and ✓/✗ mark agreement with the ground truth, which the model does not see.
4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en:
Given a keyframe I I , the face bounding box O O of an observer, and the face bounding boxes { C k } k = 1 K \{C_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} of K K candidates, we predict the index y ^ ∈ { 1 , … , K } \hat{y}\in\{1,\dots,K\} of the attended person.
As shown in Fig. 3 , Nunchi works in three stages.
Cue extraction obtains gaze and speaker information with frozen expert models and collects the transcript.
Prompt construction writes the expert outputs as text and labels each candidate as C k C_{k} in the image and in every cue.
Candidate scoring reads the images and the prompt with a single VLM.
Because all information enters through the input, cues can be added or removed without changing the architecture.
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个键框 I, 一个观察者的面框 O, 以及 K 候选人的面框 { C k } k = 1 K \{ C _{k = 1 }^{K }, 我们预测 索引 y ^ { 1, ..., K }\ hat{ y}\in \{1,\ dots, K } 参加的人 。
如法智所显. 3,农志分三个阶段工作.
Cue提取器用冷冻的专家模型获取视线和扬声器信息,并收集笔录.
快速构建将专家产出写成文本,并在图像和每个提示中将每个候选人标注为Ck C_{k}。
候选人评分读取图像和提示,使用单一的VLM.
由于所有信息都通过输入进入,提示可以添加或删除而无需改变架构.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cue Extraction
blocks.zh: 4.2 采掘

blocks.en:
Gaze-LLE [ 35 ] (ViT-L, trained on GazeFollow [ 33 ] ) takes the keyframe and the face box of O O and outputs a gaze heatmap.
For each candidate, m k m_{k} is the fraction of the heatmap mass inside its face box enlarged by 1.5 × 1.5\times .
LR-ASD [ 23 ] , an active speaker detection model trained on AVA-ActiveSpeaker [ 34 ] , predicts from the face tracks of Sec. 3 and the audio whether each person is speaking in each frame.
Averaging these scores over the current utterance gives a k a_{k} for each candidate and a O a_{O} for the observer, so a high a k a_{k} means that C k C_{k} is likely speaking.
We use the human-written transcripts of the source datasets by default, and Whisper [ 32 ] transcripts in Sec. 5.4 .
blocks.zh:
Gaze-LLE [35] (ViT-L,接受GazeFollow[33]训练) 取O键框和面盒,并输出凝视热图.
对每个候选人来说, mk m_{k}是其面盒内热映射质量的一小部分,放大1.5×1.5\时。
LR-ASD [23],一个接受过AVA-ActiveSpeaker[34]训练的活跃的扬声器检测模型,从Sec. 3的面轨和音频中预测每个人是否在每个帧中说话.
将这些分数放在目前的语句上, 给每个候选人一个 k a_{k , 给观察者一个 O a_{k , 所以高一个 k a_{k , 表示 C k C_{k 可能发言 。
我们默认使用源数据集的人文笔录,以及Whisper [32] Sec. 5.4的笔录.

blocks.en: 4.3 Prompt Construction
blocks.zh: 4.3 迅速建造

blocks.en:
The VLM receives two images and a text prompt.
The first image is the keyframe with face boxes, which serves as a visual prompt [ 45 ] . O O is drawn in green, and each candidate is drawn in yellow with its label C k C_{k} .
The second image is a 448 × 448 448\times 448 observer crop.
The prompt states that O O looks at exactly one of the candidates and lists their labels.
The gaze prior and each cue then follow as separate paragraphs that refer to the candidates by the same labels.
blocks.zh:
VLM接收两个图像和一个文本提示.
第一个图像是带有面框的键框,它作为视觉的提示[45]. O O是用绿色绘制的,每个候选人用黄色绘制,其标签为Ck C_{k}.
第二个图像是448×448 448\时的448观察作物.
提示称O查看了其中一名候选人并列出其标签.
前面的视线和每个提示作为单独的段落,用相同的标签提及候选人。

blocks.en:
The candidates are listed in descending order of m k m_{k} , with whether the heatmap peak falls in each box and the distance from the peak to the box center.
The paragraph also gives the coordinates of the peak and of the face center of O O , and the fraction of the mass outside all candidate boxes, which is large when the heatmap misses the candidates.
Its top-ranked candidate is the prediction of zero-shot Gaze-LLE.
The two images and this paragraph form the base input.
blocks.zh:
考生以mk m_{k}的降序排列,包括热映射峰是否落在每个盒子中,以及从高峰到盒子中心的距离.
该段还给出了O O的峰值和面部中心的坐标,以及所有候选框外的质量的一小部分,当热映射错过候选框时,质量是很大的.
其排名最高的候选人是预言零弹的Gaze-LLE.
这两个图像和本段构成基础输入.

blocks.en: The speaker cue lists a O a_{O} and all a k a_{k} , together with the top-scoring face in the frame.
blocks.zh: 扬声器提示会列出一个O a_{O}和一个所有k a_{k}, 以及框中最高得分的面孔。

blocks.en:
The transcript cue gives the current utterance and the two preceding ones, each with its start offset in frames from the keyframe.
We remove the speaker name of each utterance, so that speaker information comes only from the speaker cue.
We also replace the names of O O and the candidates with their labels, using the character identities of Sec. 3 , e.g . , “Ross, come here” becomes “ C 2 \text{C}_{2} , come here”.
The supplementary material shows a complete prompt.
blocks.zh:
笔录提示给出了当前的话语和前两段话语,每段话语的起始句从键框中抵消.
我们删除每句话的发言者姓名,因此,发言者的信息只来自发言者提示。
我们还使用Sec. 3的性格身份,例如“Ross,过来”改为“C 2\text{C}_{2},过来”。
补充材料显示是完全迅速的。

blocks.en: 4.4 Candidate Scoring and Training
blocks.zh: 4.4 候选人的分红和培训

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 4 ] as the VLM and append the prefix {"answer": "C to the prompt, so that the next token is a candidate index.
The logit z k z_{k} of index k k is the score of C k C_{k} , and y ^ = arg ⁡ max k ⁡ z k \hat{y}=\arg\max_{k}z_{k} .
All scores come from one forward pass over the images and the prompt, so the VLM weighs the cues against each other when they disagree.
We fine-tune the language model with LoRA [ 18 ] and freeze the vision encoder.
The target is a JSON object with the answer first, followed by a short rationale that templates fill from the annotations, including the current speaker, as detailed in the supplementary material.
The loss covers all target tokens.
At inference, z k z_{k} is read before any rationale token is generated, so the prediction does not depend on the generated rationale.
blocks.zh:

索引 k k 的 logit z k z_{k = c k C_{k = 分数 y ^ = arg 最大 k ⁡ z k = hat{y}=\arg\max_{k}z_{k = .
所有得分都来自一个前方,通过图像和即时,所以VLM在出现分歧时会相互权衡提示.

目标是一个JSON对象,首先有答案,然后有一个简短的理由,模板从说明中填充,包括当前发言者,详见补充材料.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We train our model on SORBET and evaluate it on SORBET and, without further training, on two existing datasets, VGS [ 17 ] and AVA-LAEO [ 24 ] .
We choose them because their official videos include audio, from which the speaker and transcript cues are obtained.
We do not use UCO-LAEO [ 24 ] , whose videos partly come from the same TV series as SORBET.
VGS consists of conversational videos with gaze target annotations, and we use all 266 samples from its 11 videos.
AVA-LAEO provides looking-at-each-other labels on AVA movies [ 12 ] , and the candidate face tracks come from AVA-ActiveSpeaker [ 34 ] .
As it has no official test split, we evaluate on 322 samples from the AVA validation movies.
For an in-domain comparison, we also train a separate model on 601 training and 174 validation samples from the AVA training movies.
Samples from both datasets follow SORBET, so the observer looks at one of two or more candidates, but the speaker need not be visible.
As neither dataset provides transcripts, we generate them with Whisper [ 32 ] and keep names as spoken.
blocks.zh:
我们在SORBET上培训我们的模型,并在SORBET上评价它,在没有进一步培训的情况下,在两个现有数据集上培训VGS[17]和AVA-LAEO[24]。
我们之所以选择他们,是因为他们的官方视频包括音频,从中获取演讲者和记录提示。
我们不使用UCO-LAEO [24],他们的视频部分来自与SORBET相同的电视连续剧.
VGS由有目光目标说明的对话视频组成,我们使用其11个视频的所有266个样本.
AVA-LAEO在AVA电影上提供逐一观看的标签[12],候选的面孔音轨来自AVA-ActiveSpeaker[34].
由于它没有正式的测试分裂,我们评价了AVA验证电影的322个样本.
为了进行域内比较,我们还从AVA训练电影中培训了601个培训和174个验证样本的单独模型.
两个数据集的样本都遵循SORBET,因此观察者看两个或两个以上候选人中的一个,但演讲者不需要可见.
由于两个数据集都没有提供记录誊本,我们用Whisper [32] 生成这些记录,并保留姓名为口语.

blocks.en:
We compare against existing models that can identify the attended person.
Gaze-LLE [ 35 ] and Sharingan [ 38 ] are heatmap-based gaze following models.
MTGS [ 15 ] is a social gaze model that predicts each person’s LAH probability, and we also provide its official speaking-status input with the same LR-ASD scores as ours.
MMGaze [ 17 ] is a multimodal gaze following model that takes the image and audio and estimates the speaker with its own module. Each model is evaluated with its released checkpoint and after fine-tuning on SORBET with its official recipe and our training and validation sets.
We also fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B [ 4 ] , InternVL3.5-8B [ 42 ] , and Qwen2.5-Omni-7B [ 44 ] on our input without the gaze prior, that is, the two images with or without the conversational cues. 2 2 2 We use the official code and checkpoints released by the authors for all baselines, including the VLMs, except MMGaze, which we train on SORBET from ImageNet initialization because this gives higher accuracy than fine-tuning its released checkpoint. Its top-scoring box overlaps no candidate face in 26.2% of the test samples. All MMGaze configurations are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了现有的能够识别受助人的模式.
Gaze-LLE [35] 和 sharean [38] 是跟随模型的热映射式凝视.
MTGS [15] 是一个预测每个人LAH概率的社会凝视模型,我们也以与我们相同的LR-ASD分数提供官方的语音状态输入.
MMGaze [17] 是一种仿照模型的多模式凝视,它将图像和音频带入,并用自己的模块来估计扬声器. 每一个模型都经过了检查点的评估,并在SORBET上进行了微调,并配有其官方食谱和我们的培训和验证装置。
我们还微调了Quen3-VL-8B [4], InternVL3.5-8B [42], 和Quen2.5-Omni-7B [44] 的输入, 没有之前的视线, 即有或没有对话提示的两个图像。 2个 2 我们使用作者为包括VLM在内的所有基线发布的官方代码和检查站,但MMGaze除外,我们从ImageNet初始化开始在SORBET上培训MMGaze,因为这比调整其已发布的检查站更准确。 其顶级评分盒在26.2%的测试样本中与无考生面相重叠. 所有MMGaze配置都在补充材料中.

blocks.en:
We report identity accuracy, the top-1 accuracy over the candidates.
We do not use the LAH F1 of MTGS [ 15 ] , since its precision is always 1 when every sample has a person target.
Gaze-LLE and Sharingan select the candidate with the largest heatmap mass in its 1.5 × 1.5\times enlarged face box, and selecting by the heatmap peak gives similar results in the supplementary material.
MTGS selects the candidate with the highest LAH probability, MMGaze the candidate matching its top-scoring detected box, and VLMs the candidate with the highest logit z k z_{k} described in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh:
我们报告身份准确度 候选人的第一准确度
我们不使用MTGS [15] 的LAH F1,因为当每个样本都有个人目标时,它的精度总是1.
Gaze-LLE和Sharingan在1.5×1.5\x加宽的面框中选择热映射质量最大的候选人,通过热映射峰的选用在补充材料中给出了类似的结果.
MTGS选用LAH概率最高的候选人,MMGaze选用与其检测到的顶级评分框匹配的候选人,VLM选用在Sec.4.4中描述的对数最高的候选人.

blocks.en:
Our model is built on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and implemented in PyTorch [ 31 ] on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
We apply LoRA (rank 32, α = 64 \alpha{=}64 ) to the language model and keep the vision encoder frozen.
We train with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) and an effective batch size of 8 for at most two epochs, selecting the epoch on 400 fixed validation samples.
All VLMs, including the baselines, use the same settings.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型基于Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct,在PyTorch[31]中执行,在一个单NVIDIA A100 GPU上.
我们把LORA(排名32,α = 64\alpha{=}64)应用到语言模型中,使视觉编码器保持冻结.
我们用 AdamW (学习率 10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 ) 来训练, 有效的批量尺寸为 8, 最多两个时代, 选择400个固定验证样本的时代。
所有VLM,包括基线,都使用相同的设置.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 5.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison on the SORBET test set. Each column shows the candidate predicted by a method, with an arrow from the observer O O (green) to the prediction (yellow).
Green and red marks indicate correct and incorrect predictions.
We show examples where the gaze following and social gaze models fail and our model succeeds.
blocks.zh:
图4:SORBET测试集的质量比较. 每栏显示通过一种方法预言的候选人,箭头从观察者O O(绿色)到预测(黄色).
绿色和红色标记表示的是正确和不正确的预测.
我们举出一些例子,说明跟随的目光和社会目光模型失败,我们的模型成功。

blocks.en:
Table 4 compares our model with gaze following, social gaze, and multimodal gaze following models, and with VLMs.
With the speaker and transcript cues, our model reaches 86.7%, the highest accuracy among them overall and on each of the three series.
It outperforms the strongest existing method, Gaze-LLE with its decoder fine-tuned on SORBET, by 4.8 points.
The gain does not come from model size, since the same Qwen3-VL-8B without the gaze prior stays below the fine-tuned Gaze-LLE even with both cues.
With five or more candidates, it reaches 76.0%, 8.0 points above the next best method, Qwen3-VL with the conversational cues but without the gaze prior.
The conversational cues add 9.0 points there, against 3.4 points over all samples.
The cues also raise the accuracy of all three VLMs without the gaze prior. Figure 4 shows such cases.
The speaker and transcript cues thus help most when many people are present.
blocks.zh:
表4将我们的模型与跟随的目光、社会目光和跟随模型的多式联运目光以及VLM进行比较。
我们的机型达到了86.7%, 总体准确度最高,
它的性能超过了最强的现有方法Gaze-LLE在SORBET上的解码器微调,得分4.8分.
增益并不来自模型大小,因为相同的Qwen3-VL-8B没有前置的视线停留在微调后的Gaze-LLE之下,甚至有两种提示.
有5个或更多候选人,它达到76.0%,比次佳方法高8.0分,Qwen3-VL带有对话提示,但没有前视线.
对话提示增加9.0分,而所有样本的比分是3.4分.
提示还提高了所有三种VLM的准确性,没有前视. 图4显示了这种情况。
因此,当许多人在场时,演讲和记录提示最有帮助。

blocks.en:
How the cues are given also matters.
MTGS receives the same LR-ASD scores as our speaker cue but gains 0.8 points from them, whereas our model gains 1.9 points.
MMGaze estimates the speaker with its own module and reaches 57.3%.
Both fuse the speaker information with visual features inside their networks, whereas our model reads the speaker scores as text next to the gaze prior.
As a simpler way to combine the same scores, we replace the VLM with a logistic regression on m k m_{k} and a k a_{k} of each candidate.
As detailed in the supplementary material, it reaches 83.9%, below the 85.2% of our model with the speaker cue, and it cannot use the transcript.
When the gaze prior and the speaker cue point to different candidates, the gap over the logistic regression grows from 2.8 to 7.4 points, since Nunchi weighs the cues per sample instead of with fixed weights.
The benefit of the speaker cue thus depends on how a model combines it with gaze geometry.
blocks.zh:
如何给出提示也很重要。
MTGS得到的LR-ASD分数与我们的演讲者提示相同,但从中得0.8分,而我们的模型则得1.9分。
MMGaze用自己的模块估计演讲者比例达到57.3%。
两人将演讲者信息与网络中的视觉功能连接起来,而我们的模型则将演讲者评分作为前视线旁边的文字。
作为合并相同分数的简单方法,我们用每个候选人的m k m_{k}和k a_{k}的逻辑回归来取代VLM。
如补充材料所详述的,它达到了83.9%,低于85.2%的音标,它不能使用笔录。
当前面的目光和演讲者提示指向不同的候选人时,后勤回归的差距从2.8点增加到7.4点,因为Nunchi用固定的权重来权衡每个样本的提示。
因此,演讲者的好处取决于一个模型如何将其与视线几何结合。

Table 5 tests whether the gain comes from conversational cues or simply from adding more cues.
We add each cue to the base input, the two images and the gaze prior of Sec. 4.3 .
Besides the speaker and transcript cues, we test four visual cues.
Depth gives the relative depth of O O and each candidate from Depth Anything V2 [ 46 ] .
Reciprocal gives the share of each candidate’s Gaze-LLE heatmap that falls on the face of O O .
Graph states whom each candidate looks at most, from the same per-candidate heatmaps.
Arrow adds a third image with an arrow from the face of O O to the peak of its heatmap.
Details and full results are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
表5测试收益是来自对话提示还是仅仅来自增加更多提示.
我们把每个提示加到底部输入器,两个图像和四点三司之前的视线上。
除了扬声器和笔录提示 我们测试四个视觉提示
深度给出OO的相对深度,以及来自深度任意V2[46]的每个候选人.
对等给每个候选人的Gaze-LLE热图,
图表显示每个候选人最多看谁,从相同的每个候选人的热图。
箭头在其热映射的峰值上加上了第三幅图像,从O O的正面射出一箭.
详细情况和全部结果见补充材料。

blocks.en:
Combining the speaker and transcript cues gives the best accuracy, 3.4 points above the base input.
The speaker cue alone adds 1.9 points, while the transcript alone changes the accuracy little but adds 1.5 points on top of the speaker cue.
What is said thus becomes informative once the speaker is known.
In contrast, none of the visual cues improves the base input.
Three of them come from the same Gaze-LLE as the gaze prior and likely add little new information.
In Fig. 5 , depth and reciprocal keep the base input’s wrong prediction, whereas the conversational cues correct it.
Conversational cues thus provide information that gaze geometry cannot.
blocks.zh:
将扬声器和笔录提示结合起来,最准确,比基础输入值高3.4分.
单是演讲者提示就增加了1.9分,而单是记录片就很少改变准确性,但在演讲者提示上只增加了1.5分。
因此,一旦发言人被了解,所说的话就变得内容丰富。
相比之下,视觉提示中没有一个改进了基础输入.
其中3种来源于与之前的目光相同的Gaze-LLE,可能增加的新信息很少.
在图5中,深度和对等性保留了基础输入的错误预测,而对话提示则纠正了它。
因此,对话提示提供了无法观察几何的信息。

blocks.en:
In Tab. 6 , we add the gaze prior and conversational cues to each VLM, separately and together.
The conversational cues alone raise every VLM by 5.0 to 6.7 points, and the gaze prior alone by 7.1 to 10.3 points.
Both together give the largest gain for every VLM, 10.5 to 14.3 points.
Gaze geometry and conversational cues thus play complementary roles, and the gain does not come from the VLM alone.
Qwen3-VL-8B performs best and is our backbone; results with per-cue and zero-shot results are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
在表6中,我们将视线前提示和对话提示加到每个VLM上,单独和一起.
单是对话提示将每个VLM提升5.0至6.7分,而仅前视点就提升7.1至10.3分.
两者加在一起为每个VLM带来最大的收益,10.5到14.3分.
盖兹几何和对话提示因此发挥互补作用,而收益并非仅来自VLM.
Qune3-VL-8B的性能最好,是我们的主干;每场比赛和零镜头比赛的结果都在补充材料中。

blocks.en: 5.4 Results on Existing Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.4 现有数据集的结果

blocks.en:
Table 7 tests whether the gains hold with automatic transcripts and on existing datasets.
Replacing human transcripts with Whisper transcripts costs only 0.3 points on SORBET.
On VGS and AVA-LAEO, our model trained on SORBET is applied without further training, and its accuracy rises with the speaker cue and again with the Whisper transcript.
The gaze labels come from the original datasets, and the speaker need not be visible, so the gains do not depend on our annotation or sample selection.
The cues help even though the attended person is the current speaker in only 10.5% of samples on VGS and 33.2% on AVA-LAEO, against 60.9% on the SORBET test set.
On AVA-LAEO, the cross-dataset model reaches 91.0%, comparable to the in-domain model at 89.4%.
Conversational cues thus help beyond SORBET, even with automatic transcripts.
blocks.zh:
表7检验收益是否持有自动记录誊本以及现有数据集。
在SORBET上,用Whisper的笔录代替人类笔录只花费0.3分.
在VGS和AVA-LAEO上,我们接受过SORBET训练的模型在没有经过进一步训练的情况下被应用,它的准确性随扬声器提示而上升,再次随Whisper记录片而上升.
凝视标签来自原始数据集,演讲者无需可见,因此收益并不取决于我们的注释或样本选择.
尽管在VGS上只有10.5%的样本和在AVA-LAEO上只有33.2%的样本中受助者是现在的演讲者,而在SORBET测试中则有60.9%。
在AVA-LAEO上,跨数据集模型达到91.0%,与域内模型相比为89.4%.
因此,对话提示在SORBET之外有所帮助,即使有自动记录。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
SORBET is built from scripted TV series, where acting and camera framing follow a script.
We use a single keyframe and assume that the observer looks at one of the candidates, so gaze shifts and gaze at objects or off-screen people are not covered.
Mapping names in the transcript to faces requires the character identities of the people in the scene.
On VGS, the base input falls below zero-shot Gaze-LLE, 48.9% against 51.5%, so the VLM trained on SORBET does not always transfer.
Raw audio given directly to Qwen2.5-Omni stays below the explicit cues in the supplementary material, and using audio and multiple frames end to end is left for future work.
blocks.zh:
SORBET由脚本电视连续剧构建而成,其中的演技和相机设定跟随剧本.
我们使用一个单一的键框,并假设观察者看一个候选者,所以不覆盖对物体或屏幕外的人的视线和视线。
将笔录中的名字映射到面部需要现场人物的身份.
在VGS上,基础输入低于零射的Gaze-LLE,48.9%对51.5%,因此在SORBET上训练的VLM并不总是传输.
直接提供给Quen2.5-Omni的原始音频留在补充材料的显式提示以下,使用音频和多帧结尾到结尾则留待未来工作.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We formulated attended person identification in multi-party conversations, where gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear.
We built SORBET with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, and proposed Nunchi, which combines gaze geometry with conversational cues in a single VLM.
Nunchi outperforms gaze following, social gaze, and VLM baselines, and conversational cues help across VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on existing datasets.
Additional visual cues, in contrast, do not help.
The SORBET annotations and our code will be made publicly available.
We hope SORBET and Nunchi lead to gaze models that listen as well as look.
blocks.zh:
我们在多党对话中设计了有人员参加的人身份,随着更多的人出现,仅目光几何就变得模糊不清。
我们建立了SORBET, 配有同步的演讲,文字记录, 和出席的人的标签, 并提议Nunchi, 将视线几何和对话的提示结合在一个单一的VLM。
Nunchi的目光、社交目光、VLM基线和对话提示都比目光、自动记录和现有数据集的目光要好。
相比之下,其他视觉提示没有帮助。
SORBET说明和我们的代码将公开发布.
我们希望SORBET 和 Nunchi 引导的目光模型 既听又看。
